summary: Adds a new skill for returns disposition audits that involve multi-file Excel joins, alias normalization, and event status filtering. The existing excel-audit-reporting skill covers single-file multi-sheet audits; this new skill handles the distinct pattern of joining separate Excel files (Plan + Event Log + Alias Map), normalizing values via case-insensitive alias lookups, filtering events by status (e.g., COMPLETED only), and computing missing/mismatch flags. Includes a reusable script template and reference for multi-file join patterns.
